Common Questions

Do I need good credit? +

No. We work with families who have been turned down by banks. Your credit score does not disqualify you from our program.

Do I need a bank? +

No. Our entire process is designed for people who can't get traditional bank financing. No bank approval needed.

Is this really free? +

Yes. The training is 100% free with no obligation. We believe in educating you first so you can make the best decision for your family.

How much do I need for a down payment? +

It varies by property, but we work with families who have as little as $5,000 saved. The training covers exactly what to expect.

What areas do you serve? +

We serve the entire OKC metro — Oklahoma City, Moore, Norman, Edmond, Midwest City, Yukon, Del City, Bethany, Newcastle, Tulsa, and more.
